title: West Fraser Declares Dividend
author: Prnewswire
description: West Fraser Timber Co. Ltd. has declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.32 per share on its Common and Class B Common shares, payable on July 13, 2026 to shareholders of record on June 25, 2026. Dividends are payable in U.S. dollars with an option for Canadian dollar election.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company's declaration of a quarterly dividend of US$0.32 per share demonstrates financial strength and confidence in cash generation. Regular dividend payments are a positive signal to investors, indicating the company's ability to return capital while maintaining operations across its diversified wood products business with 50+ facilities globally.

title: Medium Density Fiberboard (MDF) Market to Hit USD 78.57 Billion by 2033, Driven by Rising Demand for Eco-Friendly Furniture and Cost-Effective Construction Materials | SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global MDF market is projected to grow from USD 44.39 billion in 2025 to USD 78.57 billion by 2033, driven by rising demand for eco-friendly furniture, sustainable construction materials, and modular interior solutions. The U.S. segment is expected to grow from USD 5.68 billion to USD 9.88 billion over the same period. Standard MDF and furniture applications currently dominate the market, while moisture-resistant MDF and construction applications are experiencing the fastest growth rates.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Identified as a key market player benefiting from overall MDF market growth, but no company-specific developments or challenges highlighted.
